newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Banks' stocks push Mauritius bourse index down.
newsitem.headline: Banks' stocks push Mauritius bourse index down.

text.p: Falling shares in the banking sector pushed down the Mauritius bourse market index, Semdex which eased 0.71 points on Monday to 317.70, dealers said.
Provisional volume was posted at 2.42 million rupees on 71,324 shares from 11.08 million rupees on 999,040 shares last Friday.

"Stocks traded mixed on Monday still in the absence of a general market trend. The heavyweights Mauritius Commercial Bank and State Bank of Mauritius forced the Semdex down as upmoving stocks were more or less offsetting the downmoving ones," a dealer said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank ended 50 cents down to 71.50 rupees on a thin 335 shares and State Bank of Mauritius eased 10 cents to 8.50 rupees on 5,003 shares.
Thin transaction volume characterised trading on Monday as dealers said the Mauritian market was hit by a "weekend effect."
"It (weekend effect) has been on for sometime now and you will notice volume on Mondays is thin relative to the other days of the week. This applies again for today," the dealer said.
Caudan Debentures attracted the majority of Monday's volume. Caudan closed flat at 1,085 rupees on 685 units traded.
Mauritius Union Assurance gained 1.50 rupees to 46 on 3,000 shares. Plastic Industries Mauritius slumped 40 cents to 5.60 rupees but attracted no volume.
Mauritius Oil Refineries (Moroil) surged 50 cents to 8.80 rupees but with no volume traded. Moroil reported a 57 percent jump in pre-tax profit for the financial year ending 30 June 1996.
Building blocks manufacturer United Basalt rose 10 cents 25.50 rupees on 1,350 shares.
In the investment sector, United Docks lost 20 cents to 39.50 rupees on 700 shares despite reporting a 9 percent rise in pre-tax profit for the financial year ending 30 June 1996.

Consolidated Investment Trust (CIT) was unchanged at 9 rupees on 4,399 shares and Fincorp Investment was stable at 71 rupees on 645 shares. National Investment Trust (NIT) was up 10 cents to 11.20 rupees on 4,450 shares.

Sugar based Mon Tresor Mon Desert was unchanged at 35 rupees on 5,850 shares. Conglomerate Rogers remained at 89 rupees on 1,050 shares and Happy World Foods was unchanged at 14 rupees on 4,695 shares.
Hotel concern Sun Resorts rose 20 cents to 35.70 rupees on 5,388 shares while New Mauritius Hotels shed 30 cents to 27.50 rupees on 10,490 shares.
Shell (Mauritius) was 20 cents down to 15 rupees on 4,100 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius ended unchanged at 50 rupees on 1,250 shares.
